scope: Two distinct licensed source clips, four original model-route evidence interpretations, separately counted assisted revisions, local guard checks and a hosted preflight stop. No general accuracy, provider ranking or native-hearing claim.

source_release.contains: Standard-library evidence builder, five offline adapters, synthetic demo and validation tools.

music_interpretation.evaluation_scope: Faithful and useful interpretation of supplied measurements and, for q17 only, plots. No source audio or receiving-host audio inference.

packet.contents: Measurements, plots, source/time/channel definitions and interpretation instructions
Five unchanged Geometry JSON/CSV files plus source/time/method/attribution envelope; no plots or Signal Core/downmix measurements

lessons: Correct numerical comparisons can coexist with unsupported musical conclusions; both must be checked.
Low spectral flatness does not uniquely establish a pure tone, and a monophonic pitch estimate is not verified physical periodicity.
A higher window average does not establish a constant signal or monotonic change within that window.
Missing beat candidates do not establish that rhythmic events stopped.
Global channel summaries do not establish local balance, phase, stereo width or mono behavior.

ordinary_fixture_cases: Early command exit with a child holding the output pipe

hosted_process_api_diagnostic.scope: The single owned-process lifecycle behavior exercised in that diagnostic

hosted_command_guard_cap_request.reason: The documented execution interface supplies a yield timeout, not the enforced outer termination timeout required by the request.
hosted_command_guard_cap_request.evidence_limit: Returned records and source equality independently checked; this is not independent operating-system telemetry or proof about undisclosed backend controls.

prerequisites: Separately reviewed update bound to that accepted environment

limits: Two source clips and assisted corrections do not establish general accuracy or provider ranking.
Accepted supplied-evidence interpretation does not establish native hearing or independent acoustic truth.
Local guard checks are not hosted tests, installation acceptance or audio tests.
Historical acceptance does not establish current or indefinite sandbox residence.
A reviewed preflight stop is not a passing execution result.
